evidence.reason: a preview binds no evidence to any subject; it copies no badge from the installed definition

comparison.equality_scope: the ordered inferred input/output types and admitted effects only; equal descriptions are not behavioural equivalence and not acceptance

dependents.scope: current named dependents whose resolved calls reach the replaced definition

unreachable.reason: this path holds no worker and issues no guest request; those two counters are structural constants here
